scope: All five residual whole-token četyrih/šestih cardinal forms in the four Latin sources, all in the base papers and all governed as genitives.
choice: Normalize četyrih to official cardinal genitive četyrěh at three sites and šestih to official cardinal genitive šesti at two sites.
motivation: Official cardinal declension distinguishes the ancient-dual genitive četyrěh for four and noun-like genitive šesti for six. The five source forms import South-shaped adjectival -ih morphology into cardinal slots; each German control is a genitive phrase with four or six.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining četyrih was rejected because official cardinal grammar gives exact genitive/locative četyrěh, not an adjectival -ih form.
Retaining šestih was rejected because numerals from five upward decline like kost, whose genitive is šesti; -ih is adjectival and unsupported here.

Leaving all cardinal numerals uninflected was rejected because the official grammar permits that only as an easy fallback and explicitly recommends the inflected patterns for better effect; these sentences already mark the genitive relation.
Changing the following plural nouns was rejected because form and redov/razloženij already occupy the correct number/case required by their clauses.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official isv_words_list.csv, 7993414 bytes, SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: row 1685 / ID 2856 gives type-1 cardinal četyri; row 15987 / ID 1739 gives type-1 cardinal šesť and directly exemplifies genitive šesti.
evidence.official_grammar: Official numerals.md, 12907 bytes, SHA-256 4E0D13888444D6005CB886118726F8F8EF0BD5280434BD1EF66C9BFB3AE9A05C, lines 37-60 declares the cardinal declension classes, though its embedded tables are not materialized in the snapshot. The current official grammar page https://interslavic.fun/learn/grammar/numerals/, checked 2026-08-13, gives exact genitive/locative četyrěh in the 2-4 table and exact genitive šesti via the 5-99 kost pattern.
evidence.german_authority: German ED0014 noether.tex, 2154011 bytes, SHA-256 EE226847656BC4D65EDDA9E9BF9BB1D25797C0C6D672D267D94A97FD88C7AD58: lines 1206 and 1311 have aus/von sechs Formen; lines 9707, 9712 and 12159 have von vier Reihen, im Fall von vier Reihen, and der vier verschiedenen Zerlegungen.
evidence.semantic_audit: The five sites denote exactly six forms twice, four rows twice, and four different decompositions once. No ordinal, fraction, proper name, quotation, or formula token is involved.
evidence.protected_domains: No target occurs in a comment, control name, label, citation key, URL, foreign-language/title argument, bibliography identity, or formula token.

validation.coverage: The two exact source forms total five tokens at the declared line/column locators; all become zero.
validation.postcondition: Exact whole-token četyrěh appears three times and šesti twice; neither source form remains.
validation.structure: Only the base source changes, by plus one UTF-8 byte net. Line count, raw braces, ordered TeX-control stream and math-delimiter stream remain identical; the other sources are byte-identical.
